description: This file defines functions and types related to configuring secrets and providers in the openclaw project, including building configuration candidates, detecting changes, and creating secret plans.

methods.name: getSecretProviders
methods.description: Retrieves secret providers from the given OpenClawConfig, returning an empty object if not present.

methods.name: buildConfigureCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of configuration candidates based on the provided OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: configureCandidateSortKey
methods.description: Generates a sort key for configuration candidates, prioritizing auth profiles.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileProvider
methods.description: Resolves the provider for an auth profile based on store and path segments.

methods.name: buildConfigureCandidatesForScope
methods.description: Builds configuration candidates within a specific scope, considering auth profiles and secret targets.

methods.name: hasPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists within a root object.

methods.name: collectConfigureProviderChanges
methods.description: Detects changes in secret providers between two configurations, returning upserts and deletes.

methods.name: hasConfigurePlanChanges
methods.description: Determines if there are any changes in the configuration plan based on selected targets and provider changes.

methods.name: buildSecretsConfigurePlan
methods.description: Constructs a secrets apply plan based on selected targets and provider changes.
